title: Yu9191/wloc
claim: Yu9191/wloc — 修改 Apple 网络定位（gs-loc）返回坐标 · 支持 Surge / Quantumult X / Loon / Stash · 快捷指令一键设置/恢复定位
why_good: The project addresses a growing need for privacy and control over location data, appealing to users concerned about surveillance.
value: Users could pay for a premium subscription to access advanced features, while businesses could license the technology for enhanced privacy tools.
risk: The project may struggle to scale if larger tech companies integrate similar features into their existing products.
pick_reason: The project is a modification tool for existing apps and lacks a clear monetizable product.
